stem.text: The diagram shows two parachutists, X and Y, moving vertically downwards.

stem.alt: Drawing of a parachutist hanging from a parachute, labelled X.
Drawing of a parachutist hanging from a parachute, labelled Y.

stem.text: The total mass of parachutist Y and his parachute is twice the total mass of parachutist X and his parachute. At this moment, the air resistance on parachute Y is twice the air resistance on parachute X. Neither parachutist has reached his constant (terminal) velocity.
Which statement describes the acceleration of Y compared with the acceleration of X?

A.text: The acceleration of Y is half the acceleration of X.

B.text: The acceleration of Y is the same as the acceleration of X.

C.text: The acceleration of Y is more than the acceleration of X, but less than twice the value.

D.text: The acceleration of Y is twice the acceleration of X.
